messages.subject: Independent Telemetry "behind the scenes"
parts:
Hi All,

I am currently running scr data with telemetry data on white-tailed deer. This data is independent of each other and I can successfully get both CHs loaded and ran on simple models. The issue comes when I start running models that combine the two types of data. 
I am wondering how telemetry data informs density in "independent" models, it is more than sigma?  The densities vary greatly between models. Please see our outputs below at the differences between them. 



Any help would be appreciated. Let me know if I can offer more information.
Ashley

As you suspect, independent telemetry data inform sigma, and density only indirectly. I may be able to explain the discrepancy between models 1 and 3 if you send the data and code to me offline.
Murray
